title: Peer/deliver: sentAt stored verbatim with no format validation
description: DeliverMessageArgs.sent_at is a String from an untrusted peer, stored verbatim in messages.sent_at_peer (TEXT, no CHECK constraint). A peer can store an arbitrary string (64KB blob, emoji sequence, injection attempt). The value is exposed in Message/get responses to owner clients. Each new client (native, mobile, TUI) that parses sentAt must handle malformed values defensively. Fix: validate sent_at parses as RFC 3339 in validate_attachments equivalent, or add a DB CHECK constraint, or both.
